subject: Request: Short runway top-up while PO completes supplier onboarding
messages:
From: Evelyn O'Neill <evelyn.oneill@medisupplier.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medisupplier.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — short runway top-up while PO finishes onboarding

Hi Mina,

We're excited to move forward with Redwood for the pilot — engineering has already started integration work. Unfortunately, our vendor onboarding team flagged a few missing items in legal/vendor intake and the PO routing is going to be pushed out by ~7–10 business days.

We need a small safety window so the sandbox doesn't expire while the PO is routing. Would Redwood consider a 5–7 day sandbox top-up or a short trial extension while procurement finishes their checks? I attached the PO draft we've prepared so you can see the committed spend and approvers.

Attachments: medisupplier_po_draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Evelyn O'Neill
Head of Product
Medisupplier Inc.
E: evelyn.oneill@medisupplier.com
T: +1 415-555-0199
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn O'Neill <evelyn.oneill@medisupplier.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway top-up while PO finishes onboarding

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help prevent the demo from stalling. Proposed immediate steps:
- I can provision a 5-business-day sandbox voucher today to keep your team warm while procurement completes their checks.
- If legal/finance confirm a signed PO before the voucher expires, we'll convert the pilot to the committed trial and remove any usage caps.

One ask: please confirm the final approver email on the PO and an expected PO release date (approx). Also, can procurement confirm whether any additional security questionnaires are required (SOC2 attestation, etc.) — that helps us avoid surprises when moving to a paid environment.

I'll loop in Camila on the logistics and Karthik for any pricing or credit approvals we need.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
E: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
T: +1 646-555-0222
